A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GNP research work. The main text, equations, tables, figures and appendices are readable, and retained material can be matched across renumbering and relocation.

before.justification: v2 reports original evaluations on 867 SuiteSparse matrices, including preconditioner comparisons, timing and failure results, design ablations and convergence histories.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds final-residual rankings, an AIR-versus-SA evaluation and further matrix-specific convergence results.

M1.justification: The nonlinear FGMRES procedure, scale-equivariant GNN architecture, Arnoldi/Gaussian training mixture and L1 residual loss are retained. Additional scalability and implementation discussion does not change GNP's procedure.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same 867 non-SPD, real SuiteSparse matrices from 50 application areas. The AIR subset and expanded histories use existing matrix coverage; no new dataset, task or input scenario is introduced.

E2.justification: The main comparator set is unchanged. However, v3 Figure 10 adds Jacobi to the first three appendix convergence comparisons, where v2 Figure 9 showed GNP, AMG, GMRES and no preconditioner. New Appendix F.5 compares AIR with SA separately; it does not establish a direct GNP-versus-AIR comparison.

E3.justification: Appendix F.1 adds final-relative-residual ranking under the two existing stopping rules. F.5 introduces an AIR/SA test with replacement smoothers and 83 completed nonsymmetric systems. The main matrix selection, GNP training budget, AUC metrics and stopping settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Supplementary validation expands substantially: F.1 checks sensitivity to the ranking metric, F.5 tests an alternative AMG solver and diagnoses failures, and F.6 extends selected convergence examples to all evaluated systems in three application areas. The original training-data and scale-equivariance ablations remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The added percentages and problem counts do not introduce uncertainty estimation; existing distribution-reporting practices are retained.

E6.justification: Tables 1-3 and the main benchmark figures retain their results, but substantial supplementary results are added. New Figure 7 reports GNP winning 16.0% and 19.8% under final-residual ranking with iteration/time stopping. Table 4 adds AIR/SA win-loss-tie counts of 14/8/61 by iterations and 50/29/4 by residual. Figures 10-18 revise or expand convergence histories, including longer time trajectories; these are not established same-setting performance gains.

T1.justification: Theorem 1, Corollary 2, their proofs and the sampling derivations are retained. New Appendix E adds an asymptotic argument for O(nz(A)) computation and a storage expression nz(A) + cn for the existing architecture.

C1.justification: The abstract, four stated contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about algebraic neural preconditioning, convergence analysis, training-data generation, scale-equivariance and broad evaluation. Added evidence does not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: v3 explicitly limits the convergence analysis to infinite precision, explains the fixed test solution and L1 loss choices, expands memory/scalability considerations, and interprets AIR's mixed results and implementation failures. Existing central interpretations and per-matrix training limitations remain.

D1.justification: New Appendix A provides a GNP implementation repository link. F.5 identifies the SA/AIR solver entry points and smoother changes. The existing architecture hyperparameters, training configuration, hardware and primary baseline settings are retained.

R1.justification: v3 adds Trifonov et al. on learned factor corrections, Arioli and Duff on finite-precision FGMRES stability, and two Manteuffel et al. AIR papers. These locally extend positioning without replacing the principal related-work argument.

P1.justification: The main narrative and section order remain largely unchanged. v3 makes localized wording edits, adopts conference-style headings and author-year citations, adds acknowledgments and targeted appendix subsections, and renumbers the retained appendices.

P2.justification: The visual appendix expands substantially with final-residual pie charts, Table 4 and multi-panel Figures 11-18. Figure 9 becomes a revised Figure 10 with additional curves and updated legends/time panels. Conference formatting also relocates existing displays, including Table 2 and Figure 6.

improvement.justification: The final-residual check and broader convergence histories make the retained empirical claims easier to assess. The implementation link and clearer precision/scalability discussion also improve transparency. These are useful refinements to unchanged core work; the AIR comparison stops after 83 nonsymmetric systems because of a hang, so it only partly addresses baseline adequacy.
